title: RBX Agent Memory Item
description: A typed, scoped memory item in the RBX agent memory taxonomy. Memory aids agents in working but is not the source of canonical truth. Agents must verify long_term_canonical items against the current repository or ADR state before acting.

type.description: Memory layer. short_term: task/session scope, TTL minutes-hours. medium_term: project/epic scope, TTL days-weeks. long_term_canonical: institutional truth (ADRs, schemas, registries), permanent until deprecated.

source.description: Where this memory originated. Examples: agent_id, tool name, document path, ADR ID.

scope.description: What this memory applies to. Examples: mission/<mission_id>, project/robson, repo/thalamus-core, global.

owner.description: agent_id or 'operator'. The entity responsible for this memory item's accuracy.

confidence.description: Estimated reliability [0,1]. 1.0 = verified canonical truth. <0.5 = uncertain, should be re-verified before acting.

created_at.description: RFC3339 timestamp of when this memory was created.

expires_at.description: RFC3339 expiry timestamp. Null means no expiry (long_term_canonical items are typically null). Expired items are excluded from retrieval and marked deprecated.

canonical_reference.description: Path or URI to the authoritative source for this memory item. Required for long_term_canonical items. Examples: docs/adr/ADR-0001.md, spec/manifest.schema.json, https://rbxsystems.com/schemas/...

status.description: Lifecycle status. draft: unverified. working: in use but not validated. validated: verified against canonical source. canonical: is the canonical source. deprecated: superseded or expired.

content.description: Memory payload. Structure is type-specific. Should not contain secrets, credentials, or PII.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the memory content.

data.description: Structured memory data. Schema depends on memory use case.

mission_id.description: Mission this memory is associated with, if applicable.

session_id.description: Session this memory was created in, if applicable.

agent_id.description: agent_id of the agent that created or last updated this memory item.

verified_at.description: When this memory was last verified against its canonical_reference. Null means unverified.
